opening.argument: The presentation leads with an extraordinary return claim—“67%+/DAY”—and pairs it with an assurance that the bot can provide “very easy passive income.” It then directs viewers into a technical funding process: use Remix to deploy Solidity code, deposit at least 0.2 ETH to the contract or bot address, and start the bot. The claimed mechanism is not ordinary investing; it is to sandwich another transaction by paying a higher gas fee and profit from the resulting slippage difference. Even the description acknowledges that “the contract will basically waste in fees more than make profit” under some conditions. Thus, the code, destination, returns, and any losses remain unverified while viewers are encouraged to commit funds to a creator-attributed trading bot promising unusually high daily returns.
